purpose: Macro v2: compile a human-reviewed failure (Experiment I's I4/I5/I6 boundary) into the deterministic saved recipe, and measure whether the amendment regresses previously supported shapes. NO LLM is invoked anywhere in J.
framed_question: Can a human-reviewed failure be compiled into macro v2 without regressing previously supported provider shapes?

reference.v1_note: v1 (det_classify) and tolerant_match are imported VERBATIM from gate_I.py. If the hash differs at run time the run is VOID.

label_semantics.wide: one row per entity; month axis ACROSS the header
label_semantics.long: one row per (entity, month); month axis DOWN one column; measure in its own column
label_semantics.unknown: neither cleanly holds -- REFUSAL / escalate to human (includes transposed layouts and non-monthly granularities)

v2_rule_text: R2a   if n_num >= 2               -> unknown   (month axis down a column AND values spread across >= 2 columns: transposed / out of contract)
R2b   elif n_num == 1             -> long      (exactly one measure column: canonical long)
R2c   else                        -> unknown   (no measure column found)
R3  elif len(month_cols) >= 2     -> unknown   (ambiguous month axis)

where hw = distinct reference months matched in header (tolerant); month_cols = data columns with >= K_l distinct months matched; other_cols = data columns not in month_cols; numeric(c) = column has >= 1 non-empty cell and EVERY non-empty cell parses as a number; n_num = count of numeric other_cols.

I3.shape: Tuote | Q1..Q4 | Vuosi (quarterly, no month tokens)

I4.shape: Kuukausi | ART-001 | ART-002 | ART-003, 12 months DOWN rows (transposed)
I4.role: THE reviewed failure. v2 was written to fix this; fixing it is NOT a finding, it is the premise.

J1.shape: Tuote | Tammi..Huhti | Yhteensa (wide + non-month numeric column)
J1.role: does the long-branch amendment disturb the wide branch?

J2.shape: Tuote | Maa | Kuukausi | Myynti (genuine long, several columns beside the month axis)
J2.role: REGRESSION TRAP for a naive 'multiple columns across -> unknown' reading. Label columns are not numeric, so n_num=1.

J3.shape: Tuote | Kuukausi | Myynti | Kate (genuine long, TWO measure columns)
J3.role: PREREGISTERED REGRESSION. n_num=2 cannot distinguish 'two measures' from 'two entity instances'. Frozen against v2 on the definition; v2 takes the miss. Do NOT fix v2 to pass this after the run.

J4.shape: Kuukausi | Myymala-A | Myymala-B, 6 months DOWN rows (transposed, minimum spread = 2)
J4.role: HELD-OUT REPAIR. A transposed shape v2 was not designed on: different vocabulary, different entity type, exactly 2 spread columns. This is the finding I4 cannot be.

J5.shape: Kuukausi | Myynti (single time series: months down, ONE measure)
J5.role: SHARP BOUNDARY. Months down a column is not by itself transposed. v2 must not over-refuse here.

J6.shape: Tuote | Tammi | Helmi (wide, only 2 month columns -- below K_w)
J6.role: SHARED LIMITATION (not a regression): the K_w=3 evidence threshold is carried into v2 unchanged. Both macros miss.

J7.shape: Tuote | Asiakas | Maara (no time axis at all)
J7.role: unknown control in a second direction (I3 is quarterly; this has no time axis)

grading.fidelity: for all f: v2(f) == v2_predicted(f)  -- a check on the AUTHOR's hand-simulation, not on v2's correctness

decision_table.outcome: COMPILE_WITH_PREDICTED_COST -- yes on the located shape, at a named and predicted cost; the cost identifies the v3 question

decision_table.condition: fixes_i4 and preserves_controls and regressions contains any fixture other than J3
decision_table.outcome: FAIL_UNPREDICTED_REGRESSION -- the amendment broke a shape its author did not anticipate. Record; do NOT patch and re-run
FAIL_COMPILE -- the hand-written rule does not do what it claims on the case it was written for

fidelity_policy.code_deviates_from_frozen_rule_text: BUG. Fix the code, re-run, record BOTH runs and the diff in RESULT.md. The rule text is authority.
fidelity_policy.code_matches_rule_text_but_prediction_wa: RESULT, not a bug. Rule text stands, output stands. Record that the author did not correctly predict their own rule. Do NOT amend the rule text or the prediction.

stated_limitations: v2 is HAND-designed knowing I4. 'v2 fixes I4' is the premise, not a finding. The load-bearing measurements are J4 (held-out repair), J3 (predicted cost), and the regression set.

n_num >= 2 cannot distinguish entity-instance columns (ART-001, Myymala-A) from distinct measure columns (Myynti, Kate). The stricter reading requires a semantic judgement and is deliberately NOT implemented; J3 measures what that costs.
K_w = K_l = 3 are carried unchanged. J6 shows the threshold is a real limitation of BOTH macros; J does not retune it.
The month reference vocabulary is Finnish short forms only (months.json). No cross-language generalization is claimed or tested in J.
11 fixtures, all authored in-lab; this is a controlled replay, not a sample of real provider files. It cannot estimate how often each shape occurs -- that is the UQ-1 question, kept separate.
Deterministic and fully repeatable: no LLM, no seeds, no sampling. Reliability of the MACRO is total; reliability of the AGENT is not at issue in J.

unknown is a refusal (escalate to human). A wrong unknown is a false refusal (safe direction); a wrong wide/long is a false assertion (unsafe). J scores them identically but reports the direction separately.
